name: Create account with email confirmation
description: Verifies a new user can create a TradeSnap account from the public app and receives confirmation instructions.
steps: Enter a new email and password
Choose Client and submit Create account
expected: TradeSnap confirms the account was created and instructs the user to check email; no Supabase dashboard is required.

name: Sign in and reach workspace
description: Verifies an existing confirmed user can sign in and reach the TradeSnap workspace.
steps: Enter a confirmed account email and password
expected: The user is redirected to the TradeSnap workspace and sees their signed-in email.

name: Reject invalid signup input
description: Verifies weak credentials are rejected before an account request is sent.
steps: Enter an invalid email or short password
expected: A validation message is shown and the account is not created.
